_meta.company: Unnamed AI Research Organisation (via Gazelle Global)

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating transformer-based language models. Compressed TinyLlama 1.1B via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization, benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; built a GPT-2 style LLM from scratch; and ran distributed training on SLURM-managed clusters.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset, improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing improvements and model tuning.
Built PyTorch training and evaluation pipelines with modular data loaders reusable across transformer model variants.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom detection dataset; trained and evaluated YOLOv8 models improving classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5%; deployed in a consumer mobile app.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI data; benchmarked on Dice Score and IoU with accuracy-latency trade-off reporting.
Engineered custom data pipeline with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management; led team of 7 to deliver full pipeline within a 6-week window.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced model memory footprint by ~25% via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B; benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC — ~7% accuracy drop, +6.3 perplexity increase.
Quantified model efficiency vs. task performance trade-offs to characterize compression impact across downstream benchmarks.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer in PyTorch (multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, weight tying) with TikToken tokenizer and training loop with perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built end-to-end ASR: 80-channel mel encoder, 6-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention; 15% WER on Hindi-English corpus (1,000 samples), training loss ~0.51.
Designed Cython-accelerated BPE tokenizer achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python on 6M characters.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers on a SLURM-managed cluster; achieved 10.49× speedup with 12 processes and characterized load-imbalance causing up to 65% performance degradation.

1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
